subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding the derivative as the instantaneous rate of change (slope of a tangent line)
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student measures the slope of secant lines getting progressively closer together on a physical curve model to approximate the tangent slope
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a curve's steepness at a point to its correct approximate derivative value
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what the derivative represents at a given point on a function

misconception_flags: confuses the derivative (instantaneous rate) with the average rate of change over an interval

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
